text: Cave Johnson here. This week the robot learned two things. When to give up, and when to jump.
Exhibit one. A lava pool, sealed in bedrock. Last week's robot waited by it for two and a half minutes. This one gives up after twenty seconds, and goes to the open pool next door.
Exhibit two. Underground, the iron pickaxe wears out. The old robot went looking for a tree. This one makes a stone pickaxe from the cobblestone in its pocket.
Then, in the interest of science, it walked into a lava pool. The way out was one block up. It never jumped. That one is on the released build.
So we taught it to jump. Baritone had the rule already: in a liquid, below the next step, hold jump. Same pit. Forty-four seconds before. Six after.
Three runs each, and the median went from twenty-eight seconds to nine. Two runs from the checkpoint that killed it: no deaths, and both reached the Nether.
Version zero point nine five, point six six. Out now.
